data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Wikipedia infobox, then timeanddate time, then a Geography note) and names both parameters. However, it reads the capital from the infobox, whereas the true workflow takes capital as an input. It also adds a timezone and says "World Clock" rather than the search box with Enter. It is also vague on UI details such as clicking "New note" and pressing Enter, and on how capital_city is sourced, so an automation would need some guesswork.
